title: CRO Submission Export
description: Generate CRO-ready compound submission package with SMILES, assay data, and project metadata for outsourced synthesis/testing.

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

compound_csv.description: CSV with columns: compound_id, smiles, potency (IC50 nM), safety (hERG IC50 μM), composite_score.

cro_target.description: CRO vendor name for the submission header and formatting.

top_n.description: Number of top compounds to include in the submission package.

herg_safe_threshold.description: hERG IC50 safety threshold (μM). Compounds flagged if below this.

assay_name.description: Primary assay name for the CRO submission form.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline.

outdir.description: The output directory where results will be saved.
